question: For each pizza order, provide a single result row with the row ID, order ID, customer ID, pizza name, and final set of ingredients. The final ingredients are determined by starting with the standard toppings from the pizza’s recipe, removing any excluded toppings, and adding any extra toppings. Present the ingredients in a string starting with the pizza name followed by ': ', with ingredients listed in alphabetical order. Ingredients appearing multiple times (e.g., from standard and extra toppings) should be prefixed with '2x' and listed first, followed by single-occurrence ingredients, both in alphabetical order. Group by row ID, order ID, pizza name, and order time to ensure each order appears once. Sort results by row ID in ascending order. Assign pizza_id 1 to 'Meatlovers' pizzas and pizza_id 2 to all others.
sql:
-- Final solution with pizza_id included
WITH base AS (
    SELECT 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) as row_id,
        order_id,
        customer_id,
        pizza_id,
        exclusions,
        extras,
        order_time
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders
),
pizza_info AS (
    SELECT 
        b.row_id,
        b.order_id,
        b.customer_id,
        b.exclusions,
        b.extras,
        b.order_time,
        pn.pizza_name,
        pr.toppings as recipe_toppings
    FROM base b
    JOIN pizza_names pn ON b.pizza_id = pn.pizza_id
    JOIN pizza_recipes pr ON b.pizza_id = pr.pizza_id
),
standard_toppings AS (
    SELECT 
        pi.row_id,
        pi.order_id,
        pi.customer_id,
        pi.exclusions,
        pi.extras,
        pi.order_time,
        pi.pizza_name,
        trim(t.value) as topping_id,
        pt.topping_name
    FROM pizza_info pi,
         UNNEST(string_split(pi.recipe_toppings, ',')) AS t(value)
    JOIN pizza_toppings pt ON trim(t.value)::INTEGER = pt.topping_id
),
excluded_names AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        pi.row_id,
        trim(t.value)::INTEGER as topping_id,
        pt.topping_name
    FROM pizza_info pi,
         UNNEST(string_split(pi.exclusions, ',')) AS t(value)
    JOIN pizza_toppings pt ON trim(t.value)::INTEGER = pt.topping_id
    WHERE pi.exclusions IS NOT NULL
),
extra_names AS (
    SELECT 
        pi.row_id,
        pi.order_id,
        pi.customer_id,
        pi.order_time,
        pi.pizza_name,
        trim(t.value)::INTEGER as topping_id,
        pt.topping_name
    FROM pizza_info pi,
         UNNEST(string_split(pi.extras, ',')) AS t(value)
    JOIN pizza_toppings pt ON trim(t.value)::INTEGER = pt.topping_id
    WHERE pi.extras IS NOT NULL
),
final_toppings AS (
    SELECT st.row_id, st.order_id, st.customer_id, st.order_time, st.pizza_name, st.topping_name, 1 as cnt
    FROM standard_toppings st
    LEFT JOIN excluded_names ex ON st.row_id = ex.row_id AND st.topping_name = ex.topping_name
    WHERE ex.topping_name IS NULL
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT en.row_id, en.order_id, en.customer_id, en.order_time, en.pizza_name, en.topping_name, 1
    FROM extra_names en
),
topping_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        row_id, order_id, customer_id, order_time, pizza_name, topping_name,
        SUM(cnt) as total_count
    FROM final_toppings
    GROUP BY row_id, order_id, customer_id, order_time, pizza_name, topping_name
),
formatted AS (
    SELECT 
        row_id, order_id, customer_id, order_time, pizza_name, topping_name, total_count,
        CASE WHEN total_count >= 2 THEN '2x' || topping_name ELSE topping_name END as formatted_topping
    FROM topping_counts
),
result AS (
    SELECT 
        row_id,
        order_id,
        customer_id,
        pizza_name,
        pizza_name || ': ' || 
            string_agg(formatted_topping, ', ' ORDER BY 
                CASE WHEN total_count >= 2 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                formatted_topping
            ) as ingredients
    FROM formatted
    GROUP BY row_id, order_id, customer_id, order_time, pizza_name
)
SELECT 
    row_id,
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    pizza_name,
    ingredients
FROM result
ORDER BY row_id
